name: Jaw-chewing with Falim gum 8 hours

lead: People chew very hard Turkish gum such as Falim for many hours a day, in some accounts up to eight, aiming for a bigger, wider masseter and a stronger-looking lower face.

Repetitive heavy chewing loads the masseter, which can enlarge with heavy use; clinical descriptions list constant gum chewing among causes of masseter hypertrophy, which can change facial shape. Forum users describe both enlargement they welcome and pain. No clinical trial of marathon chewing for appearance was located.

paras: Users chew in long daily sessions, often spread across the day, and compare progress by checking jaw width over weeks and months.

Reported effects include jaw pain, clicking or popping, pressure near the ear and more masseter bulk than intended. Temporomandibular literature lists gum chewing as a suggested contributor to jaw problems.

angle.text: A wider, stronger lower face from a bigger masseter. Hours of hard gum chewing load the muscle so it grows. Muscle enlargement from heavy chewing is documented, while appearance results from such long sessions are reported by users, who also report jaw pain.

lead: Extended Falim chewing is a practice in looksmaxxing communities in which people chew Falim, a hard Turkish gum, for hours a day, in some accounts up to eight, to enlarge the masseter and widen or strengthen the lower face.

The masseter is known to enlarge with heavy use; clinical descriptions list clenching, bruxism and constant gum chewing as causes of masseter hypertrophy, which can change facial shape and is sometimes linked to temporomandibular joint problems.[1][2] Forum users describe both enlargement they welcome and jaw pain they attribute to long sessions.
No clinical trial of marathon chewing for appearance was located for this entry.
infobox: Falim and similar hard or mastic gums

paras: Practitioners chew one or several pieces of hard gum at once, for sessions that users in threads describe as lasting many hours. Some say gum softens too fast and move to stiffer gums or mastic.
Users say the practice widens the face, strengthens the jaw and improves symmetry. Some report enlargement large enough that they sought masseter botulinum toxin injections afterward.
Others report discomfort. One thread describes pressure near the ear, jaw popping when yawning and pain even when eating bread after chewing sessions.

Reference sources describe masseter hypertrophy from constant gum chewing, usually painless and bilateral, and note it may be linked to temporomandibular joint problems.[1] Descriptions of temporomandibular disorders list excessive gum chewing among suggested parafunctional habits, but state that no specific evidence supports it and that the role of parafunction is debated.[2]
No studies found. Related background: clinical descriptions of masseter hypertrophy report that constant gum chewing can enlarge the muscle.[1]

lore.intro: On looksmax.org, Falim threads mix reports of visible jaw growth with reports of jaw pain.

claims.claim: Hours of Falim chewing widens and strengthens the jaw
Long chewing sessions can hurt the jaw joint
